name: saturn
note: banded gas giant with its ring system; the ring plane is the planet's equator, i.e. perpendicular to the globe's spin axis, which puts the camera's equatorial orbit ~17 deg above it and the sun ~21 deg above it (so the rings read as an ellipse and cast a shadow band across the bands). Set tilt_deg to 26.73 to model Saturn's actual obliquity instead
